main_text.p: specialiter, Viri, Num.13.4. Constr. אַנְשֵׁי[?] Viri, Gen.17. v.27. Aff. אַנְשֶׁיךָ[?] Viri tui, 1.Reg.10.8.
אנש[?] אנשא[?] אנשא[?] Chald. Homo, Dan.7.4.8. Quisquam, Dan.2.10. Plural. אֲנָשִׁים[?] Viri, Dan.4.14.
נשים[?] Quod hic adducunt, vide in נָשָׁה[?].
* אנתה[?] Pronomen, Chald. Vide in אֲנִי[?].
אםם masc. Horreum: Plural. cum Aff. אַסְמֶיךָ[?] Horrea tua, Prov.3.10. Extat & Deut.28.8.
אםן m. Exitium, Genes.42.4. Aben Esra מוֹת[?] Mortem exponit.

אםף Congregavit, Collegit, Retraxit, Recepit: Construitur cum praepositione אֶל[?], exceptis tri-bus locis, in quibus construitur cum עַל[?], ut tradit Masora, Amos 3.9. Quomodo a קבץ[?] differat, vide illic: Praeter. אָסַף[?] Recepit, Genes.30.23. אָסְפוּ[?] Recipient, Retrahent ad se, Joel. 2. v.10. Particip. Plural. Constr. אֹסְפֵי[?] Intercepti, Ezech.34.29. Futur. תֶּאֱסֹף[?] Recipies, Psal.104.29. abs q א[?]. Niph. נֵאֱסַף[?] Collectus, Congregatus, Receptus, Sublatus fuit: vel Congregavit se: Praeter. נֵאֱסַף[?] Recipitur, Jes.57.1. Pih.Particip. מְאַסֵּף[?] Colligens, Jer.9.22. Plur. cum Aff. מְאַסְּפָיו[?] Colligentes illud, Jes.62.9. Dagesch irre-gulariter ejecto. Pyh.Praeter. וְאָסַף[?] Et colligitur, Jes.33.4. וְאֻסְּפוּ[?] Et congregabuntur, Hos.10.10. Partic. מָאֻסָּף[?] Re-ceptus, Ezech.38.12. Hiph. Futurum. אֹסִיף[?] Tollam te, 1.Sam.15.6. Et contractum, אָסְף[?] Recepturus sum, Soph. 1. v.2.3. quod à סוּף[?] esse potest. Hitchp. Infinit. בְּהִתְאַסֵּף[?] Dum congregarent se, Deut.33.5.
אסף m. Collectio, Jes.32.10. Plur. Constr. בְּאֻסְפֵי קַיִץ[?] Sicut collectiones aestatus, Mich.7.1.
אֲסֻפִים[?] m. p. Collectae, Res congregatae, 1.Par.26.15.
